name: pop
declaration: unsafe fn pop < 'a > (& mut self) -> Option < & 'a T >
documentation:
Pops an entry from the front of the list.

 # Safety

 The caller must make sure to synchronize ending the borrow of the
 return value and deallocation of the containing entry.
rules: The caller must synchronize the end of the borrow of the value returned by `pop` with deallocation of the entry containing that value, so that the entry is not deallocated while the returned borrow is active.
